title: nessie service record
description: One Service: a Host, port and protocol where any Result has a port other than 0. Emitted by the starter services extension, owned by nessie. Draft (2026-11-23), schema version 1.

schema_version.description: Counted per kind. A reader refuses a version it doesn't know.

svc_name.description: 22964's svc_name when it fired on this port; otherwise the most common, a name ending in ? losing to one without.

plugin_ids.description: The Nessus plugin IDs that fired on this endpoint.
